cause: The explicit Mach-O function sections omitted regular,pure_instructions. Darwin ld reports that those symbols have unwind information but the section is not classified as code; objdump -d also omits the new section.
fix: Add the code-section flags to the Mach-O function attribute. The ELF section attribute and Linux machine code are unchanged. R1418 will rerun locally before remote profiling; R1411 needs corrected Mach-O source, portable checks and proof of identical Linux objects before any publication.
